events.title: MPC Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Refining Results
events.body: Marathon Petroleum tops Q1 estimates as refining margins surge, while a new $5B buyback boosts total repurchase capacity.

events.title: Marathon Petroleum Q1 Earnings Call Highlights
